title: 第1168章 暗潮涌动针对李易第1167章 坑赵天海韩如雪守护
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
玄阴峰，圣女殿。
厚重的殿门在身后合拢，将外间的喧闹与窥探全部隔绝，殿内寒玉生烟，灵气沁人，与方才灼热的火海判若两界。
李易立在殿中，衣袍边角带着灼烧后的焦痕，肌肤表层还残留着神火烫伤的细密红痕。
他看着韩如雪，语气真诚：
“师姐，今日之事，是我连累了你，为了护我，你当众与楚烈对峙，触怒神火峰一脉，还给自己招惹了无尽非议。”
韩如雪纤躯静立，清冷眸子扫过他身上的伤势，神色平和，
“前因后果我皆已知晓，楚焱设局坑害你在先，楚烈恃强伤你在后，你一切都是被动应对，无需自责。
合欢宗圣子、圣女之位，本就存在博弈纷争，而且楚烈对我执念深重，早晚都会滋生事端，与你无关。”
李易面带感激道：
“无论如何，今日我都要谢谢你，若非你及时赶到，我很可能无法活着走出神火峰，还浪费你数个时辰为我护法。”
“你我既以缔结道侣，本就应该互帮互助、共修大道，我护你，也是在护我自己的道。”
韩如雪回得很坦然。
眸光落在李易焦黑的衣摆和裸露肌肤上尚未愈合的火痕，上下打量了一番，眼中掠过一抹探究，
“现在，我更好奇了，以准神的境界，是如何走到神君试炼火域的？”
“这三千年来，我未得名师指点，宗门资源培养，炼气修行缓慢，不过幸运的是，在一个秘境得到了炼体功法。
于是。
就按照上面记载的法门修炼，依靠不甘执念与纯阳体质，倒是让我摸出了一些名堂，将肉身修到了圣境圆满。
再加上早年孕养过一种与凤凰神火同类型至刚至阳的异火，对于此类异火的抗性大大增加，这才能走到那个区域。”
这个理由半真半假。
他的肉身确实强，异火也确实有，只是远不止圣境，异火也不止一种。

韩如雪闻言，轻轻颔首。
这个解释合乎逻辑，合欢宗虽重阴阳双修，但也并非没有体修奇才，神魔峰招收了许多肉身血脉强横的修士，如蛮牛血脉，龙象血脉，玄武血脉等等。
石凡体内血气旺盛，确实是炼体高手。
“你今日在凤凰池消耗不小，体表伤势不轻，这几日你安心静养，无需强行催动纯阳之气为我调和，先稳固自身状态为重。”
韩如雪吩咐了一句。
“多谢师姐体谅。”
李易拱了拱手，他的确需要一段安稳时间，彻底消化凤凰池海量火道本源，夯实天神圆满的根基，静待破境神君的契机。
二人简单道别。
韩如雪转身回了主殿卧房，李易则顺着回廊，独自走向偏殿。
殿门落锁，禁制布下。
李易盘膝在床上，体内阴阳二气流转，默默梳理道基，淀今日所有所得。
“主人，你入门三日，便闹出了两场巨大的风波，会不会引起宗门高层怀疑，暴露身份？”
元府内，大蟑螂担忧道。
“唉，我也想低调，可根本不行啊，若不与宗门圣女结合，很难得到阴阳混沌经中卷，抢有抢不过。”
李易无奈一叹，他现在在九星几乎是举世皆敌，若无特殊情况，他真不想太过高调。
奈何树欲静而风不止，他只能迎风而上，主动迎接一切挑战。
所幸，这几日他收获巨丰，不仅成功晋升天神境圆满，还找到了火系大道原石，算是完成了一半的目标。
他相信，自己要不了多久，便能套出阴阳混沌经的中卷。
content_en:
Xuanyin Peak, Saintess Hall.
The thick palace door closed behind him, cutting off all the noise and prying eyes outside. The cold jade inside the palace was filled with smoke, and the aura was refreshing, completely different from the scorching sea of ​​fire just now.
Li Yi stood in the hall, with scorch marks on the corners of his robe, and fine red marks from divine fire burns still remaining on the surface of his skin.
He looked at Han Ruxue and said in a sincere tone:
"Senior sister, what happened today was because of me. In order to protect me, you confronted Chu Lie in public, angering the entire Shenhuo Peak lineage, and inviting endless criticism to yourself."
Han Ruxue stood still and slender, her cold eyes scanning the injuries on his body with a calm expression.
"I already know the cause and effect. Chu Yan set up a trap to trap you first, and Chu Lie relied on force to hurt you later. You responded passively to everything, and there is no need to blame yourself.
The positions of the Holy Son and Holy Girl of the Hehuan Sect are inherently disputed, and Chu Lie is obsessed with me. Sooner or later, trouble will arise, and it has nothing to do with you. "
Li Yi said with gratitude:
"No matter what, I want to thank you today. If you hadn't arrived in time, I probably wouldn't have been able to walk out of the Divine Fire Peak alive, and you would have wasted several hours protecting me."
"Since you and I have become Taoist partners, we should help each other and cultivate the Tao together. When I protect you, I am also protecting my own Tao."
Han Ruxue replied calmly.
His eyes fell on Li Yi's charred clothes and the unhealed fire marks on his exposed skin. He looked up and down, and a look of inquiry flashed in his eyes.
"Now, I'm even more curious. How did you reach the realm of God's Trial Fire with a quasi-god?"
"In the past three thousand years, I have not received any guidance from a famous teacher, nor have the sect's resources to train me, so my Qi refining practice has been slow. However, fortunately, I obtained the body refining technique in a secret realm.
So.
Practicing according to the method recorded above, relying on my unwillingness to obsess and my pure yang constitution, I have found some tricks and cultivated my physical body to the perfection of the holy state.
In addition, in the early years, he had conceived and raised a kind of strange fire that was the same type as the Phoenix Divine Fire. His resistance to this kind of strange fire was greatly increased, and he was able to reach that area. "
This reason is half true and half false.
His physical body is indeed strong, and he does have strange fire, but it is far more than the holy realm, and there is more than one kind of strange fire.
When Han Ruxue heard this, she nodded lightly.
This explanation is logical. Although Hehuan Sect emphasizes yin and yang cultivation, it is not without physical cultivation wizards. The Divine Demon Peak has recruited many monks with strong physical bloodlines, such as Barbarian Ox Bloodline, Dragon Elephant Bloodline, Xuanwu Bloodline, etc.
Shi Fan has strong blood in his body and is indeed a master of body refining.
"You spent a lot of energy in the Phoenix Pond today, and your physical injuries are not minor. You can rest peacefully in the past few days. There is no need to forcefully use the pure Yang energy to reconcile it for me. The most important thing is to stabilize your own condition first."
Han Ruxue gave instructions.
"Thank you for your understanding, Senior Sister."
Li Yi bowed his hand. He really needed a period of stability to thoroughly digest the origins of the massive fire path in the Phoenix Pool, consolidate the foundation of the perfection of the gods, and wait for the opportunity to break through the realm of the gods.
The two said a simple goodbye.
Han Ruxue turned around and returned to the bedroom in the main hall, while Li Yi walked along the corridor to the side hall alone.
The palace door is locked and the ban is put down.
Li Yi sat cross-legged on the bed, with the yin and yang qi flowing in his body, silently combing the foundation of the Tao, and accumulating everything he gained today.
"Master, you caused two huge disturbances within three days of joining the family. Will it arouse the suspicion of the higher-ups of the sect and expose your identity?"
In Yuan Mansion, the big cockroach said worriedly.
"Oh, I also want to keep a low profile, but it's impossible. If you don't combine with the sect's saint, it will be difficult to get the Yin-Yang Chaos Sutra. You can't grab it."
Li Yi sighed helplessly. He was now almost everyone's enemy in Jiuxing. Unless there were special circumstances, he really didn't want to be too high-profile.
However, the tree wants to be still but the wind does not stop. He can only face the wind and take the initiative to meet all challenges.
Fortunately, he has gained a lot in the past few days. Not only has he successfully promoted to the Perfect God Realm, but he has also found the original stone of the Fire Element Avenue, which can be regarded as completing half of his goal.
He believes that it won't be long before he canTake out the middle volume of the Yin-Yang Chaos Sutra.
